subject: Pricing & Context-Length Profiling — Token Volumes and Budget
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — token volumes / context length profiling

Hi Alex / Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we promised: 

Summary of use case:
- Primary product: automated customer support summarization + long-form knowledge retrieval (multi-doc).
- Expected QPS: low (burst-y) but many large requests for ticket threads and full conversation histories.

What we need from you to finalize a pricing estimate:
1) Monthly token volumes (prompt + completion split if known). A rough distribution is fine (p95, median).
2) Typical prompt + completion sizes (average prompt tokens, avg completion tokens).
3) % of requests that need extended context (8k vs 32k vs 128k).
4) Budget range / target unit economics (target $ per 1M tokens or monthly budget).

What we will provide after we get those numbers:
- An initial pricing estimate including target $/1M tokens under Redwood Hosted and an option for a Dedicated commit if it makes sense.
- A recommended context-length profile: suggested 8k/32k/128k splits and any compression/summary caching suggestions to reduce cost.
- A short evaluation plan and an example token-profile CSV template to populate (attached).

Next steps: if you can reply with approximate numbers by EOD Wed (17 Mar) we’ll turn around a draft quote and cost breakdown by Fri.

Attachments: acme_token_profile.csv (token profiling template, CSV)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Cell: (415) 555-0123


From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — token volumes / context length profiling

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear ask. Below are rough numbers from our side after syncing with engineering. We’ll also attach a sample export of last month’s hits later today. 

Estimated monthly token volumes (total prompt + completion): ~25M tokens/month. 
- Prompt vs completion split: ~40% prompt, 60% completion (so roughly 10M prompt / 15M completion).
- Distribution: median request ~400 prompt tokens / 800 completion tokens. p95 prompt ~2,000 tokens, p95 completion ~6,000 tokens.

Context-length needs (approx percent of requests):
- 8k context: 70% (short threads, quick summaries)
- 32k context: 25% (full multi-doc retrieval for agents)
- 128k context: 5% (large legal/claims bundles)

Budget guidance / target unit economics:
- We’re evaluating a target of $1,200 — $1,800 per month initially for hosted inference while we validate. If unit economics look good we can scale to a committed plan.
- If helpful, target unit cost we’d love to see: ~$900 — $1,200 per 1M tokens (ballpark) for the early PoC; we understand enterprise discounts apply for committed volumes.

Attachments: sample_token_export_Mar2027.csv (will send as a follow-up email)

Happy to hop on a short call on Thu to review the quote.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Integrations | Acme Inc
alex.chen@acme.com
(202) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — token volumes / context length profiling

Alex — this is perfect, thank you. I pulled together a first-pass pricing sketch and a recommended profile based on your numbers (attached PDF). High-level notes below: 

1) Baseline hosted estimate (monthly):
- Using your 25M tokens / month and the 40/60 split, we estimate baseline spend of ~$1,450/month on Redwood Hosted using our published tiered unit prices (assuming mix of 8k/32k/128k managed via model variants). This sits inside your stated budget range.

2) Unit economics / target $/1M tokens:
- Rough effective unit cost implied by the above: ~$1,100 per 1M tokens. If you move to a 6-12 month Dedicated commit we can reduce that to ~$700–900 per 1M tokens depending on commit and burst rules.

3) Context-length guidance for cost optimization:
- Given 70% 8k and 25% 32k, we recommend: compressing small prompts via prefix caching, and caching agent state where possible to avoid re-sending entire conversation.
- Reserve 128k quota for the 5% of heavy legal bundles; we can route those to a quantized/cluster with a small add-on fee.

4) Next steps / asks (to finalize quote):
- Send the sample_token_export_Mar2027.csv you mentioned (we can ingest and run a quick token-profile to tighten the estimate).
- Confirm if you expect growth >2x in the next 6 months (this affects commit sizing).
- If you want, Jordan can set up a short eval project to run 1 week of production traffic through Redwood Hosted and capture real cost/latency numbers.

I’ve attached redwood_pricing_quote_ACME-2027-01.pdf and included a drive link to the token profiling worksheet. If you’re good with the baseline, we’ll prepare a formal quote and a short canary eval plan for Thursday or Friday.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_quote_ACME-2027-01.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — token volumes / context length profiling

Thanks all — quick operational note from my side:

- If you can share one week of raw requests (or the sample CSV Alex mentioned) we’ll run an internal token-profile job and return: avg prompt tokens, avg completion tokens, percentiles (p50/p95), and a suggested 8k/32k/128k split tuned to minimize cost while preserving fidelity.
- For the eval, we can set a safe cap in Redwood Hosted to keep costs within your stated $1,200–1,800/month range during the PoC.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
